RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait; only a cooling-down route sends it.

ShouldRetryFalse.description: Permanent refusals (unsupported capability, budget, price or token-reservation denials) tell SDKs not to retry.

OpenAiBadGateway.description: The provider was unavailable or returned an invalid or incomplete response

OpenAiBadRequest.description: HTTP 400 invalid_request_error for a closed-field, bound or type violation, or an explicit unsupported_capability on non-generation workloads; error.code distinguishes them. System One uses its separate HTTP 422 response for validation.

OpenAiNotFound.description: The model does not exist or is not available to this key and workspace (model_not_found)

OpenAiNotImplemented.description: A capability no registered deployment supports (unsupported_capability); permanent

OpenAiPayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the route's cap. A declared Content-Length over the cap is refused by the body-limit layer with the plain text `length limit exceeded`, before any handler runs; a streamed body is refused by the handler with an OpenAI-shaped JSON error of type invalid_request_error: code payload_too_large (message Request body too large) on every route that reads a request body (#432, #438); the realtime routes ignore the body, and /v1/files documents its own upload errors.

OpenAiTooManyRequests.description: Rate or concurrency limit (rate_limit_error), or a permanent budget, unresolved-usage or token-reservation denial (x-should-retry: false)

OpenAiUnauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, duplicate, unknown, revoked or no-longer-valid inference key (always authentication_error)

OpenAiUnavailable.description: Authentication, catalog or accounting storage unavailable, provider configuration unavailable, an unbounded price, or every route cooling down (Retry-After)

AnthropicErrorEnvelope.description: Anthropic-shaped /v1/messages error (protocols/messages.rs). It carries NO gateway machine code: unsupported_capability, budget_exceeded and the rest cannot be told apart except by their message.

AnthropicErrorType.description: Anthropic error.type. Anthropic's shape has no machine code, so a budget denial is a rate_limit_error distinguishable only by its message.

info.description: Complete contract (#82): every operation (models, embeddings, rerank, System One, images, Chat Completions, Responses, Messages, audio, files, batches, videos and realtime) documents its real HTTP, streaming and media contract and is wire-validated against the real handlers; no placeholder remains. Every operation authenticates with an inference key only (Bearer; /v1/messages also accepts x-api-key, GET /v1/realtime also the openai-insecure-api-key.<key> WebSocket subprotocol, never both); inference keys never authorize management and admin tokens never authorize inference. Live key, workspace, catalog and budget checks remain authoritative. The OpenAI-shaped, Anthropic-shaped, job and file error envelopes are distinct schemas and never the management ErrorEnvelope; /v1/messages errors carry no gateway machine code. x-omg-* extensions state what OpenAPI 3.1 cannot express (see docs/openapi/inference/README.md). Request integers must be JSON integer literals without a fraction, exponent or -0. Spec-following JSON Schema validators are more permissive than the server for these encodings.
info.title: Open Model Gateway inference API

close_code_triggers.1000: Idle timeout or maximum session duration, with or without an in-flight response.
close_code_triggers.1003: A binary client frame is not supported; send JSON text events.
close_code_triggers.1008: Rejected client event, event-rate limit, or live authorization/admission denial.
close_code_triggers.1009: The client WebSocket frame or assembled message exceeds the configured transport size cap (message_too_big).
close_code_triggers.1011: Fatal upstream/server failure, including invalid or unaccounted upstream events.
